create_dispatcher: create a PythonDispatcher instance to model C++ dispatcher precompute behavior
register_kernels: register kernels to a set of dispatch keys like CPU, XLA, or CompositeImplicitAutograd
get_dispatch_keys: get the list of supported dispatch keys including runtime keys and alias keys
get_computed_dispatch_table: get the computed dispatch table showing which kernel is used for each runtime backend
get_registered_kernels: get a formatted table of all kernel registrations for both runtime and alias keys
